findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/managed-review-evidence-smoke.ts:244-258 — the new runBrokeredCli helper spawns the CLI child with `env: { ...env, LATTICE_NATIVE_REVIEW_ATTESTATION_FD: '3' }` where callers pass `...process.env` (6 occurrences, 3 runBrokeredCli call sites). Because it neither strips managed-run env nor neutralizes provider process ancestry, the assertion at line 1510 ("real brokered Codex CLI closeout succeeds without requiring ps ancestry") is environment-dependent and fails on any Claude-hosted runner. The in-process sibling case at ~line 1455 avoids this by injecting `observeProcess: () => null`, but a subprocess cannot inherit that stub. Verified by single-variable elimination: (a) as-is → rejected by handlers/finding.ts:511-518 on inherited LATTICE_MANAGED_HOST_RUN_ID; (b) with LATTICE_MANAGED_HOST_RUN_ID and LATTICE_MANAGED_REVIEW_INVOCATION_FD cleared → rejected by core/native-review-evidence.ts:198-203 with 'current environment host=codex, nearest provider process=claude'; (c) run detached from provider ancestry with those env vars cleared → 'managed-review-evidence-smoke PASS'. Both guards are behaving correctly; the defect is that this newly added test encodes a hidden dependency on the host it runs under. Impact: CHK-006's own evidence suite, and the CHK-007 aggregate managed-cross-provider-suite-smoke (which fails solely on this child while every other managed child PASSes), are red on a Claude host and green on Codex — so this story's headline regression matrix is not portably reproducible, weakening it as durable gate evidence. Fix direction: have runBrokeredCli delete LATTICE_MANAGED_HOST_RUN_ID / LATTICE_MANAGED_REVIEW_INVOCATION_FD and provide a test-only ancestry-observation override (env-gated seam mirroring observeProcess) so the brokered-CLI case asserts broker-signature sufficiency without depending on the runner's real process tree.
